Remark
[Poincaré duality pairing]

Source: petersen:page-0348, petersen:page-0349 ↗ def:pet-ch9-de-rham-cohomology On a compact oriented $n$-manifold, the map \[ (\omega _1,\omega _2)\longmapsto \int _M\omega _1\wedge \omega _2 \] descends from $\Omega ^k(M)\times \Omega ^{n-k}(M)$ to a nondegenerate pairing $H^k(M)\times H^{n-k}(M)\to \mathbb R$. Consequently these two cohomology groups are dual and have equal dimension.
